en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a landscaped park in the foreground with paths, lawns, and shrubs, and a brick railway station building in the background. The station has a small tower-like entrance section on the left with the sign 'VALGA' above the doors, and a taller lattice structure or water tower behind it. People are sitting and walking in the park. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.
